guidance_decisions.name: go-api-contracts
guidance_decisions.reason: Selected: Run is an exported function whose lifecycle, cancellation, and error contract changes. Preserved its exact function type and documented callback-error precedence.

guidance_decisions.name: go-core-style
guidance_decisions.reason: Selected: implementing Go code and tests. Used guard clauses, standard-library dependencies, explicit errors, local state, owned goroutine completion, gofmt, race checks, and go vet.

guidance_decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
guidance_decisions.reason: Selected: the host now owns a periodic worker, child context, cancellation, completion, and resource release. Kept function dependencies and avoided new interfaces or options.

guidance_decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
guidance_decisions.reason: Not selected: existing host and worker remain in the same package with the same ownership and import direction. Periodic lifecycle behavior does not require a package-boundary redesign.
